sources.evidence: Page 2 manufacturer simulation plot: approximately 50–60% capacitance loss near 3.3 V; typical, not guaranteed.
Effective input/output capacitance must exceed 0.47 uF.

screening_assumptions.note: Conservative visual rounding of typical bias curve; multiplication is an engineering screen, not a manufacturer worst-case guarantee. Aging and AC amplitude excluded.

decision: Retain selected component provisionally; verify effective capacitance across actual bias, temperature, aging and ripple before release. Generic 50% derating alone is insufficient qualification.

input_capacitor_followup.status: Nominal rating confirmed in manufacturer reference sheet hosted by distributor. Effective capacitance at 5 V including bias, temperature and aging still requires verification; do not infer it from voltage rating.
